AI-1.name: AI Basics
AI-1.line: You get a clear picture of what these tools actually do, where they help and where they do not, so you can decide without guessing.

AI-2.name: AI Literacy
AI-2.line: You learn to judge AI output, spot when it is wrong, and explain to other people what it is safe to trust it with.

AI-3.name: Prompting and Tools
AI-3.line: You learn to write instructions that get usable results the first time, and which tool to open for which job.

AI-4.name: AI Systems
AI-4.line: You learn to connect prompts, files and tools into a repeatable process, so the same task stops being rebuilt from scratch every time.

AI-5.name: Agentic AI and Claude Code
AI-5.line: You learn to hand a whole task to an AI agent that can work with your files and tools, and to check its work before it goes out.

AI-6.name: Generative AI
AI-6.line: You learn to produce images, video, voice and audio to a usable standard, and keep them consistent with how your brand already looks.

AI-7.name: AI on a Budget
AI-7.line: You learn which paid tools are worth it, which free ones are enough, and how to run a proper AI setup on a small monthly spend.

AI-8.name: Data Privacy with AI
AI-8.line: You learn what is safe to put into an AI tool, what is not, and how to write simple rules the whole team can follow.

MK-1.name: Marketing Foundation
MK-1.line: You learn to name your audience, your offer and your message clearly, so everything you publish pulls in the same direction.

MK-2.name: Performance Basics
MK-2.line: You learn how paid advertising actually works, from budgets and targeting to what a result is worth, so you can spend on purpose.

MK-3.name: Content and Organic
MK-3.line: You learn to plan and produce content on a schedule you can keep, and to tell what is worth making more of.

MK-4.name: Data and Measurement
MK-4.line: You learn which numbers matter, where to find them, and how to tell real movement from noise.

AX-1.name: AI in Marketing
AX-1.line: You map your own marketing work and see exactly which parts AI should take over first.

AX-2.name: AI Content and Copy
AX-2.line: Draft, adapt and localise marketing copy with AI doing the first pass, so your time goes on judgement instead of a blank page.

AX-3.name: AI Creative and Visuals
AX-3.line: You learn to make and vary visuals and video quickly, so you can test many versions instead of betting everything on one.

AX-4.name: AI Ads and Performance
AX-4.line: You learn to build, launch and read paid campaigns, with AI helping on targeting, creative variants and day to day optimisation.

AX-5.name: AI SEO and Discovery
AX-5.line: You learn how people find you through search and through AI answers, and how to get your pages into those results.

AX-6.name: AI Data and Reporting
AX-6.line: You learn to turn raw platform data into a clear read on what happened and what to do next, without living in spreadsheets.

AX-7.name: AI CRM and Conversations
AX-7.line: You learn to handle enquiries, follow ups and customer questions with AI support, so nobody waits and nothing gets dropped.

AX-8.name: Build Your Workflow
AX-8.line: You leave with your own workflow written down and running, so the training keeps paying out long after the weekend ends.

AX-9.name: AI Dashboards, Sites and Reports
AX-9.line: You learn to build a working dashboard, page or report yourself, so you stop waiting on someone else to make one.
